summary: Facepalm: The search quota ran out partway through the scan, so this run produced one candidate. Seattle announced on Oct. 1, 2026 that it overpaid more than 900 police employees a combined $13.1 million. When staff calculated a retroactive 2024 raise, they used 2020 base pay rates instead of 2024 rates. Two accepted publishers covered it, FOX 13 Seattle and KOMO News, and I opened both pages. Most of the other leads I found were reported after the scan date, fell outside the window, were already published, or appeared only on non-accepted outlets. Genius: Scan for 2026-10-04 (window Sept 28 to Oct 4). The search tool hit its limit early, so the candidates come from pages I had already opened. The 2026 MacArthur Fellows were announced Sept. 29, which is inside the window. Earlier MacArthur candidates were set aside because no second accepted source could be found. This time the AP stories on WRAL (the full list) and PBS NewsHour (a feature) opened, which supplies an accepted news source for each fellow below. I avoided Texas, since Spradley ran Sept. 30, and the candidates span NY, NJ and IL. The FDA's Oct. 1 approval of the first heart valve designed to grow with children is promising, but only the FDA page was opened, so no accepted news source yet. Pair published.
